title: Zoho Desk Launched Blended AI Agents with Human Oversight #Shorts
description:
Learn how to use Zoho Desk's new Blended AI Agents with human oversight. Protect customer trust by requiring rep approval for AI-generated responses.

1. Go to Zoho Desk Setup, select Zia AI, and open Blended AI Agent Rules.
2. Set a confidence threshold limit requiring manual agent approval for refunds or contract queries.
3. Test the AI response draft workflow in the agent workstation before publishing live.

AI + Zoho automations every day - follow @GSXAutomation

What inspired this: https://news.google.?oc=5

This video uses an AI-generated presenter and voice.
Independent channel. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Zoho Corporation. Zoho is a trademark of Zoho Corporation.

angle.problem: Support managers fear AI agents will give incorrect information to customers without supervision.
angle.solution: Set up human oversight rules for Zoho Desk Blended AI Agents so human reps approve high-risk AI answers.
steps: Go to Zoho Desk Setup, select Zia AI, and open Blended AI Agent Rules.
Set a confidence threshold limit requiring manual agent approval for refunds or contract queries.
Test the AI response draft workflow in the agent workstation before publishing live.
angle.result: Automates routine support safely while protecting customer trust on sensitive issues.
angle.wow: Agents see instant AI-drafted replies in their workstation and approve them with one click.
angle.hook: Zoho launched Blended AI Agents with human oversight - here is how it works!
